WITH linked_fees AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal,
         (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0) AS relative_gap
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS overall_avg_rebate
  FROM linked_fees
), combinations AS (
  SELECT orderslink, ordertune,
         AVG(rebtotal) AS average_rebate,
         AVG(relative_gap) AS average_relative_gap
  FROM linked_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune
)
SELECT c.orderslink, c.ordertune, c.average_rebate,
       c.average_relative_gap,
       c.average_rebate - overall.overall_avg_rebate AS above_overall_average
FROM combinations AS c
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE c.average_rebate > overall.overall_avg_rebate
ORDER BY above_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
